description: Retrieve the full output behind a preview reference, served from the local store rather than by re-running anything. Pass `section` to say which named part of the preview you needed -- that is what teaches the next preview to keep it. Pass `claim` and `anchor` to record what you learned, so the same expansion never happens again.

anchor.description: The file that claim is about

claim.description: What the expanded content established, to carry forward as a finding

reason.description: Why the preview was not enough, if no single section covers it

ref.description: The reference printed in the preview

section.description: Which omitted section you needed (e.g. "passing tests", "library and runtime frames")

name: expand
